title: 第1699章 朱雀真身第1698章 抽签
lines: 很快，轩辕圣皇又挥手显出十数个光团。
不必想，便是为其他世家所准备。
事实也正是如此，广场两侧的阁楼中立马飞出人影，将那十几个光团尽数“瓜分”。
王扶瞧得仔细，这些世家的太上长老实力并不弱，最少也有合体中期巅峰的修为，大多数都有着尊者境的修为。
尽管并非巅峰，却也足见实力不俗了。
也难怪萧家此前担心非常，若是青炎子渡劫失败，或者他拒绝了萧家，此次八大世家之争，萧家还真有极大的可能败落下去。
而这些世家之中，又以林家、明家以及诸葛家的太上大长老修为最强，甚至比祝融子还要更盛三分，若是其他世家之人没有特殊手段，不出意外，胜者便在这三家之中诞生了。
王扶还记得叶家当初想要将萧家挤落，从而扶持另一个世家上位，以更大限度地掌控世家资源。
王扶问过叶家那位天霜尊者，似乎就是明家。
不过叶无苍已死，这明家若想成为八大世家，便只能依靠自己了，王扶倒是不会干涉什么。
至于说叶家那位天霜尊者，只要此女不蠢，便不会再行找死之事。
就在王扶思忖之时，广场上石柱忽然亮起了玄光，并冲天而起。
继而竟是形成了一方偌大的法阵，悬浮于高空之上，金光灿烂，法阵演化，不过呼吸之间便形成了一个恍若气泡一般的巨大圆球。
其中空间波动，虽看似只有千丈大小，但以王扶的眼力，自然看得出这圆球中的空间正极其夸张的扩大着。
几个眨眼的功夫，便已有万里之广。
随后轩辕圣皇手指捏诀，朝着那千丈大小的透明气泡遥遥一指，这气泡立马一分为二，化作两个较小一些的气泡。
可其中的空间，竟依旧有万里大小。
不必想，此等手段定源自这广场上的法阵。
“诸位，抽签既已结束，比试便开始吧，左边为八大世家切磋之地，右边则是其他世家切磋之地，按照所抽之签依次入内即可。”轩辕圣皇一眼扫过众人，当即宣布道。
说完此话，轩辕圣皇便与另外几人踏空而去，倒不是离去，而是进入广场最中心的一座恢宏阁楼之中，准备观战。
“哈哈……澹台弈天，没想到你我竟是第一场。”崔家那位身着墨绿长袍的鬼尊一步踏空，沙哑的声音传入所有人耳中，而他的目光则落在澹台世家的阁楼之中。
抽中“地”字签的，正是澹台世家。
“崔冥老鬼，这么多年你还是这般毛毛躁躁，不过既然你想战，老夫自当满足你。”下一瞬，一道遁光自那阁楼激射而出，于空中止住，显出一个鹤发童颜的老者。
正是澹台世家的太上大长老，澹台弈天。
“嘿嘿……”被称作崔冥的干瘦老者并未多言，咧嘴一笑后，瞬间射入左侧那个气泡空间之中。
澹台奕天冷笑一声，不甘示弱。
不过呼吸之间，二人便在那万里空间中斗法起来。
与此同时，另一边的气泡空间也有两道遁光激射而入，乃是林家与周家的太上大长老。
气泡空间乃阵法所铸，不仅空间极大，完全足够合体境修士施展神通，便是顶尖尊者想要打破，短时间也根本不可能。
众人观战，不过目光更多都放在八大世家那两人身上。
那位鬼尊乃是货真价实的顶尖尊者，于空间中施展鬼道神通，幻化遮天蔽日的鬼影穿梭厮杀，而澹台弈天修为稍弱，一个照面便落入了下风。
不过澹台世家作为阵道世家，最大的手段自然是阵道。
虽说传闻这位的阵道造诣远不如星罗子，但当其祭出一方阵盘，展开一道阵法之后，其气息大增，倒也足以与鬼尊交手了。
却也仅此而已。
当鬼尊祭出领域，那恍若阎罗鬼狱一般的世界展开之后，仅仅片刻功夫，澹台弈天便被逼得遁出气泡空间，一脸阴沉地认输，返回了阁楼之中。
“哈哈……澹台老怪，看来还是老夫技高一筹啊，可惜你澹台世家分明有一阵道大能，却被你硬生生逼得断绝了关系，实在是可悲可叹。”干瘦老者收了领域，遁出气泡空间后，免不得一阵嘲讽。
至于他口中的阵道大能，谁都清楚，正是昆仑圣地那位星罗子。
“哼！”澹台弈天尽管心中怒极，却也只是冷哼一声，毕竟，败了便是败了。
二人斗法结束，下一场便是水火相争。
content_en:
Soon, Holy Emperor Xuanyuan waved his hand and revealed a dozen light groups.
Don't think about it, it is prepared for other aristocratic families.
This was indeed the case. Figures immediately flew out of the attics on both sides of the square and "divided up" the dozen or so light groups.
Wang Fu took a closer look and found that the supreme elders of these aristocratic families were not weak in strength. They were at least at the peak of the middle stage of integration, and most of them had the cultivation of the Venerable Realm.
Although it is not the peak, it still shows that the strength is quite good.
It's no wonder that the Xiao family was very worried before. If Qing Yanzi failed to overcome the tribulation, or if he rejected the Xiao family, there was a great possibility that the Xiao family would be defeated in this battle between the eight aristocratic families.
Among these aristocratic families, the supreme elders of the Lin family, the Ming family and the Zhuge family have the strongest cultivation, even three points higher than Zhu Rongzi. If the people from other aristocratic families do not have special means, the winner will be born among these three families.
Wang Fu still remembered that the Ye family originally wanted to squeeze out the Xiao family, thereby supporting another family to ascend to the throne, so as to control the family's resources to a greater extent.
Wang Fu asked about the Venerable Tianshuang of the Ye family, who seemed to be the Ming family.
However, Ye Wucang is dead. If the Ming family wants to become one of the eight aristocratic families, they can only rely on themselves. Wang Fu will not interfere.
As for the Venerable Tianshuang of the Ye family, as long as this woman is not stupid, she will never seek death again.
Just as Wang Fu was thinking about it, the stone pillars in the square suddenly lit up with mysterious light and soared into the sky.
Then a huge magic circle was formed, suspended high in the sky, with brilliant golden light, and the magic circle evolved, but within a breath, a huge ball like a bubble was formed.
Although the space fluctuations in it seemed to be only a thousand feet in size, with Wang Fu's eyesight, he could naturally see that the space in the sphere was expanding extremely exaggeratedly.
In the blink of an eye, it is thousands of miles wide.
Then Xuanyuan Holy Emperor pinched his fingers and pointed towards the thousand-foot-sized transparent bubble. The bubble immediately split into two and turned into two smaller bubbles.
But the space within it is still thousands of miles in size.
Needless to say, these methods must originate from the magic circle in this square.
"Everyone, since the drawing of lots is over, let's start the competition. On the left is the place where the eight aristocratic families compete, and on the right is where the other aristocratic families compete. Just enter in order according to the lot drawn." Holy Emperor Xuanyuan glanced at everyone and announced immediately.
After saying this, Holy Emperor Xuanyuan and several others left in the air, not leaving, but entering a magnificent attic in the center of the square, preparing to watch the battle.
"Haha... Tantai Yitian, I didn't expect you and I to be the first." The ghost king in dark green robes from the Cui family took a step forward, and his hoarse voice reached everyone's ears, while his eyes fell on the attic of the Tantai family.
The person who won the lottery with the word "地" was the Tantai family.
"Old ghost Cui Ming, you are still so frizzy after all these years, but since you want to fight, I will satisfy you." The next moment, a ray of light shot out from the attic and stopped in the air, revealing an old man with white hair and a childish face.
It was Tantai Yitian, the supreme elder of the Tantai family.
"Hehe..." The skinny old man known as Cui Ming didn't say much. After grinning, he shot into the bubble space on the left.
Tantai Yitian sneered, unwilling to be outdone.
But within a breath, the two began to fight in the ten thousand miles of space.
At the same time, two escaping lights shot into the bubble space on the other side, and they were the supreme elders of the Lin family and the Zhou family.
The bubble space is created by the formation. Not only is the space huge, it is completely enough for Fusion Realm monks to use their magical powers. Even if the top venerables want to break it, it will be impossible in a short time.
Everyone watched the battle, but most of their eyes were on the two people from the Eight Great Aristocratic Families.
That ghost lord was a genuine top sage. He used ghost magic powers in the space to turn into ghost shadows that covered the sky and shuttled to fight. However, Tantai Yitian's cultivation was slightly weaker, so he fell into a disadvantage in one encounter.
However, as a formation family, the Tantai Family's greatest method is naturally formation formation.
Although it is rumored that this person's formation attainments are far inferior to Xing Luozi's, when he sacrifices a formation disk and deploys a formation, his aura increases greatly, which is enough to fight against the Ghost Lord.
But that's all.
When the Ghost Lord sacrificed his domain and the world like the Hell of Hell unfolded, in just a moment, Tantai Yitian was forced to escape from the bubble space, surrendered with a gloomy face, and returned to the attic.
"Haha... Old monster Tantai, it seems that I am more skilled. It's a pity that your Tantai family clearly has a lot of power, but you forcefully force them to sever their relationship. It's really sad." The skinny old man closed his domain and escaped from the bubble space, but he couldn't help but feel ridiculed.
As for the powerful formation in his mouth, everyone knew that it was Xing Luozi from Kunlun Holy Land.
"Humph!" Although Tantai Yitian was extremely angry, he just snorted coldly. After all, a defeat is a defeat.
The battle between the two is over, and the next one is a fight between fire and water.
